comment: Frozen level-cluster partition for shard assignment (schema v1). A tpage is assigned by matching its level prefix (the part before '-vis-' or '-tpage-'); unknown prefixes land in 'overflow'. This table never rebalances within schema v1. The ONE allowed pre-v1.0.0 re-cut was applied 2026-08-06: c5 exceeded the size target (576 MB material/bonkers shard), darkcave+maincave moved to c7.
